'''Football Club Twente''' ({{IPA|nl|ɛfˈseː ˈtʋɛntə}}), sometimes known internationally as '''Twente Enschede''', or simply '''Twente''', is a Dutch professional [[Association football|football]] club from [[Enschede]]. The club was formed in 1965 by the merger of [[Enschedese Boys]] with [[Sportclub Enschede]], the [[1925–26 Netherlands Football League Championship|1926 Dutch champions]]. Twente have won the [[2009–10 Eredivisie|Eredivisie]] once, the [[2010–11 KNVB Cup|KNVB Cup]] three times, and the [[2011 Johan Cruyff Shield|Johan Cruyff Shield]] twice. They also finished runners-up in the Eredivisie twice, and reached the [[1975 UEFA Cup final]], which they lost against [[Borussia Mönchengladbach]].

Twente's home ground since 1998 is [[De Grolsch Veste]]. Since 2019, the team have played in the Eredivisie, the top division of Dutch football. The club takes its name from the region of [[Twente]], the eastern part of [[Overijssel]]."}}
